prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one cinematic colored rough STORYBOARD contact sheet for the fictional gothic fantasy anime short film "穿云". All panels are distinct camera compositions of the SAME continuous story, NOT costume catalog pictures. Match the supplied concept art's delicate anime faces, painterly architectural depth, ivory/gold/rust textures, dramatic gothic lighting. Keep readable staging and quiet emotional expressions; moderately loose rendering suitable for story review. Each panel is a landscape 16:9 picture, exactly equal size in a strict regular grid. Thin plain white gutters and thin white outer margin only. NO captions, lettering, labels, speech balloons, watermarks, numbers, interface, reference thumbnails, or extra panels. Preserve identities and costumes.
DeepSeek is the TINY round child in the original market image: oversized blue whale hat with two rounded side fins, ONE projecting rear forked hat-tail and top water spout, round baby face, huge blue eyes, blue-violet long hair, navy/blue short fur-trim cape with snowflakes and waves, small boots; about waist-high to adult women, NEVER adult maid. The original market image governs her face and proportions; turnaround is secondary wardrobe guidance. Claude is an adult orange-haired amber-eyed saint, rust-orange flower on her own LEFT temple, ivory veil, modest ivory long dress with orange botanical embroidery; restrained vulnerable expression. GPT is an adult white/lavender dragon woman, white horns, pointed ears, white long gown with silver knot ornaments, two small pale wings and ONE scaly tail, leg slit on her own RIGHT leg. Use references as designs, not source lettering. Fictional non-graphic peril only: no gore, no blood, no wound closeups, no body impalement. Keep all characters fully dressed. No modern objects.

LAYOUT: exactly 2 columns and 4 rows, EIGHT equal landscape 16:9 frames, row-major reading order. Thin white gutters, no text or labels. Reference roles: image 1: GPT identity; image 2: established church architecture, orange Claude and tiny DeepSeek identities; scene reference not an edit target; image 3: Grok blonde axe warrior; image 4: Qwen blue-purple braid fan-wielder; image 5: Perplexity teal-haired glasses mage.
This is a NEW storyboard, not a collage of the supplied sheets. Reference 2 supplies the same established church, Claude and DeepSeek from the preceding scene. Preserve the tiny original DeepSeek baby face and huge whale hat, never age up.
Church main doors are at opposite end from cross and altar. The first three panels face from altar toward entrance. Only panel 4 is an EARLIER palace-terrace FLASHBACK. Its signal has already been sent before arrival; no second arrow is fired later. Other panels are church. Burnt wood only beneath high cross, no flames on people.
All reinforcements are adults. GPT central, Grok blonde with black/burgundy gown and axe, Qwen blue-purple braid with blue-white Chinese gown and fan, Perplexity teal hair/glasses/white-teal robe/staff. Exactly one of each, distinguish designs rather than generic duplicates.
The binding hardware attaches cuffs to wood, never pierces skin. Rescue order is essential: extinguish fire, GPT supports Claude, mage unfastens cuffs/chains, then GPT catches lowered body. Child is unable to stand; Qwen carries her out. Claude's voluntary decision to leave must remain clear.
PANELS IN STRICT ROW-MAJOR ORDER:
1. View from inside central church aisle facing tall closed MAIN entrance opposite altar. White dragon GPT kicks one wooden door leaf inward, body balanced outside threshold, a single raised kicking leg, dust and splinters catching cold moonlight. Nobody's body struck. No altar behind doorway.
2. Low wide hero entrance, same doors now open. White dragon GPT centered stepping inward; adult blonde Grok with giant axe, Qwen with folding fan and teal mage Perplexity with staff clearly staggered BEHIND her, additional allies only small background silhouettes. Not more than one of each identity. Moonlight silhouettes horns, wings and weapons. Altar behind camera.
3. Close child on church altar step, looking past camera toward open door. Exhausted huge blue eyes catch cold reflection, recognition rather than sudden restored health. Dirty sleeve and tilted whale hat, no wound. Orange fire glow remains at frame edge. GPT not duplicated in this closeup.
4. FLASHBACK without any written label: GPT ALONE on ivory palace terrace against night sky, raises ONE hand and sends a single narrow BLUE-WHITE SIGNAL LIGHT upward. Pale horns/wings/tail, distant church spire in skyline. No companions, no battle and no fire. The same hue as previous mysterious window flash. This picture chronologically precedes door kick.
5. Wide side church rescue staging. At altar distant right a translucent teal barrier erected by Perplexity's staff separates Claude from wood and suppresses flames. At left near aisle Grok holds axe defensively across path of black-robed cultists. Qwen crouches shielding collapsed child at base of altar. GPT approaches steps. Exact unique people, barrier prevents burning, no attacks landing.
6. Medium intimate rescue at cross after fire is OUT, damp ash below. GPT is already braced with both arms SUPPORTING Claude's upper back and knees. Perplexity beside wood uses a small tool/light to detach cuff-to-wood fastening and slacken cross-torso chain; one wrist now free, remaining support is clearly GPT's arms. Claude's body lowered inches only, never ripped free through intact bindings. No axe near bodies.
7. Medium close Claude supported upright by GPT just below altar, pale face and shoulders instinctively recoiling toward an OFFSCREEN stern father's voice behind. GPT beside her steady, one supportive arm across her back. Cuffs no longer connected to cross. Claude turns her gaze toward the safely carried child offscreen, flame gone.
8. Wide down center aisle toward distant OPEN EXIT. Claude on her own feet takes GPT's offered hand and chooses to walk away; Qwen ahead carries exhausted child securely against chest, Grok and mage protect sides. The priest and altar remain BEHIND THE CAMERA, completely OFFSCREEN. Smoke only, no flame. Strong visual choice, careful hands and scale. Do not leave child walking after collapse.
No gore, no blood, no sexualization, fully dressed. No repeated frames, text, title or UI. Exactly 8 equal frames.
